title: Text-to-speech gets two ways in
summary:
Speech endpoints, three experimental creative models, and a better gateway path for long text requests.

ElevenLabs text-to-speech was added through an OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint and a simpler GET endpoint. Both support voice selection and multiple output formats; the POST endpoint also accepts a speed setting.

Imagen 4 and FLUX.2 Dev were added for image generation, alongside Grok Imagine Video for clips up to 10 seconds. All three are marked alpha, with that experimental status visible in Enter’s model list.

The text service’s gateway was moved off a workers.dev address, removing the proxy timeout from its request path. The change addresses Cloudflare 524 errors on long-running requests, including high-effort reasoning and large-context prompts.

daily.title: Speech from text
daily.text: Generate ElevenLabs speech with `POST /v1/audio/speech` or the simpler `GET /audio/{text}`. Choose a voice and output format, and set playback speed on POST requests. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Imagen 4 joins images
daily.text: Generate images with `imagen-4`, now available as an alpha model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=imagen-4).

daily.title: FLUX.2 Dev joins images
daily.text: Try `flux-2-dev` for image generation. It’s marked alpha, so expect some rough edges. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=flux-2-dev).

daily.title: Grok Imagine Video added
daily.text: Generate clips with `grok-video`, an alpha model with a 10-second maximum duration. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-video).
